title: Gov’t asked to help Eala pay WTA fine

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker said the government should help Alex Eala pay for the $10,000 fine that the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) may impose on her, after the Filipino tennis star chose to join the national team for the coming Asian Games instead of the China Open scheduled around the same time. “If she is being fined because she chose to represent our people, isn’t it only right that the government extends its assistance or support to her?” Sen. Erwin Tulfo said in a privilege speech on Tuesday. The WTA penalty, equivalent to about P620,000, “may be a significant amount,” […]... Keep on reading: Gov’t asked to help Eala pay WTA fine
